subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared `messages.ackText` config, as a non-terminal send-and-continue plugin/channel hook, or as channel-specific placeholder features only?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but every viable fix creates new visible message-delivery semantics and either config or plugin API surface across multiple channels.

options.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
options.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel or per-account overrides, plus schema, docs, and channel delivery tests.

options.title: Add Non-Terminal Hook First
options.body: Expose a typed hook that can send interim text and continue normal dispatch, leaving acknowledgement policy to plugins or channel owners.

options.title: Keep Placeholders Channel-Specific
options.body: Use this issue for product direction while narrower Telegram, Slack, Discord, or Feishu placeholder requests own individual channel UX.

recommendation.title: Approve Shared Ack Text Config
recommendation.body: Add a default-off shared acknowledgement text contract with scope and per-channel or per-account overrides, plus schema, docs, and channel delivery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on cross-channel dispatch, acknowledgement cleanup, and prior review of this issue.
